narrative.title: The Ticket Queue Direction Flip
narrative.scenario: A support desk's ticket array is currently organized so the front holds the least urgent ticket (a min arrangement). Management wants the exact same array positions reorganized so the front holds the most urgent one (a max arrangement), in place. Since the input already satisfies the complete-tree shape, a bottom-up pass of downward fixes flips the polarity without touching the array's size.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array arr representing a valid min heap of size n.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the array reorganized into a valid max heap.
constraints: The conversion must happen in place

testCases.explanation: Sifting down from the last internal node lifts 12 to the root and settles the rest into max order.
The Floyd build pass rearranges every subtree bottom-up.

hintLevels: Level 1: Building a heap bottom-up is cheaper than n separate insertions.
Level 2: Start at the last internal node (n/2 - 1) and sift each node down toward the max orientation.
Level 3: No need to validate the min-heap input — the Floyd pass builds a valid max heap from any array.
